key_facts: AI provider implementation uses FallbackChain with GroqProvider (primary) and OpenCodeZenProvider (fallback)
GroqProvider uses proxyFetch to call Groq API with qwen/qwen3.6-27b model
OpenCodeZenProvider calls opencode.ai/zen/v1/chat/completions with big-pickle model
AiModule is imported in AppModule and provides AiService and AiController
AiService initializes providers in onModuleInit using ConfigService
Containerfile uses Fedora 44 with Node 22, pnpm 10.33.0, Rust 1.97.1
Container installs opencode-ai, codegraph, agentmemory, openspec, ast-grep as pnpm globals
call_chains: AiController -> AiService -> FallbackChain.chat() -> GroqProvider.chat() or OpenCodeZenProvider.chat()
AiService uses prompts.ts for ChatMessage generation
